apworld_description: Path of Exile 2 for Archipelago, modelled on the Path of Exile (1) randomizer.
Skill gems, support gems, passive points, gear rarity per slot, flask/charm slots, support sockets and ascendancies
are items you receive. Picking up item bases, entering zones, killing bosses and levelling up are checks you mark
in the PathOfExile2 Client. You only use what you have received - nothing is enforced by software.

tutorials.name: PathOfExile2 Setup Guide
tutorials.description: How to install and play Path of Exile 2 in Archipelago with the PathOfExile2 Client.
